title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Polished Nickel | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Towel Bar, Polished Nickel
description:
Clear counter clutter and keep towels within reach with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds storage without taking up vanity space in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces.

Highlights:
- Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Pairs seamlessly with matching Waverly Place hardware for refined continuity
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate your space with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place accessories and a cohesive look

Specs & Installation:
- Shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
- Projection: 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting: wall mount (hardware included)
- Assembly: not required
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Style: traditional / transitional bath accessories; pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware
